subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR, ask for an editable update, or close it and queue a narrow replacement fix for this cron stagger bug?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but an open closing PR already owns the issue and is not maintainer-editable, so automation should pause before starting a competing repair.

options.title: Adopt or replace the linked fix
options.body: Review `https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1175`, then either get maintainer edits enabled or open a narrow replacement that preserves contributor credit.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask the fork PR author to provide an editable, rebased branch with real behavior proof.

options.title: Close the linked PR first
options.body: If the fork PR is not worth adopting, close it and then promote a fresh ClawSweeper repair for the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the linked fix
recommendation.body: Review `https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1175`, then either get maintainer edits enabled or open a narrow replacement that preserves contributor credit.

likelyOwner.reason: The default stagger helper and its service/docs integration trace back to `steipete`'s cron stagger feature commit, making this the clearest routing owner from history.
